description: 21 security families × 26 verification lenses = 546 structured hypothesis slots. A slot is selected only when applicable to the target architecture; it is not an instruction to spray payloads.

families.name: Authentication
families.focus: login, recovery, MFA, identity proofing, credential lifecycle

families.name: Sessions
families.focus: cookies, tokens, refresh, revocation, fixation, origin and lifetime

families.name: Authorization / BOLA / BFLA
families.focus: role, tenant, seller, object ownership, direct URLs, search and bulk

families.name: Injection
families.focus: SQL/PostgREST, command, template, header, second-order and stored inputs

families.name: API Security
families.focus: schema, mass assignment, pagination, filters, webhooks, RPC and error behavior

families.name: Files / Uploads
families.focus: type confusion, path traversal, archives, parsers, storage and serving

families.name: SSRF / URL Fetching
families.focus: scheme, DNS, redirects, metadata, internal hosts and callback validation

families.name: Browser / Client
families.focus: XSS, CSP, CSRF, open redirect, DOM trust, client/server boundaries

families.name: Business Logic
families.focus: entitlement, refund, discount, quantity, workflow bypass and invariants

families.name: Payments / Accounting
families.focus: cost, payout, refund, settlement, rounding, currency and financial truth

families.name: Race / Idempotency
families.focus: TOCTOU, duplicate callbacks, retries, crash recovery, exact-once and locks

families.name: Database / Migrations / RPC
families.focus: constraints, triggers, RLS, functions, drift, ordering and rollback

families.name: Cryptography / Secrets
families.focus: key storage, token entropy, hashing, rotation, leakage and compatibility

families.name: Supply Chain
families.focus: dependencies, lockfiles, install scripts, provenance and package confusion

families.name: CI / CD
families.focus: workflow permissions, untrusted PRs, actions, artifacts, secrets and release automation

families.name: Cloud / Configuration
families.focus: environment flags, IAM, network exposure, storage, defaults and drift

families.name: Privacy / Logging
families.focus: PII, secret logs, retention, exports, redaction, observability and support data

families.name: AI / Agent / MCP
families.focus: tool authorization, prompt/tool boundaries, poisoned context, agent identity and auto-actions

families.name: Operational Security
families.focus: admin tooling, support workflows, break-glass, monitoring, runbooks and incident paths

families.name: Release Security
families.focus: build truth, migration gates, feature flags, rollback, smoke and post-deploy observation

families.name: Attack Surface Mapping
families.focus: entrypoints, identities, assets, trust boundaries, external integrations and state machines

lenses.name: missing canonical guard
lenses.question: Can the operation reach a privileged sink without the intended canonical control?

lenses.name: null or missing identity
lenses.question: Does a missing identity, owner, tenant, actor or subject fail closed?

lenses.name: lookup/read error
lenses.question: If a security-relevant lookup errors, does the path refuse rather than continue with a safe-looking default?

lenses.name: alternate endpoint
lenses.question: Does a sibling route, RPC, bulk path, search path or background worker bypass the primary control?

lenses.name: direct-object access
lenses.question: Can a caller skip UI/navigation and act directly on an object they should not control?

lenses.name: bulk operation
lenses.question: Does the bulk path enforce the same per-object invariants and report partial results honestly?

lenses.name: search/export/list
lenses.question: Can listing, search, export or autocomplete reveal objects more broadly than item endpoints allow?

lenses.name: client/server trust
lenses.question: Does client-provided state overrule stored/server/provider truth?

lenses.name: stale state
lenses.question: Can a stale preview, token, assignment, cache, price or object state be replayed after reality changed?

lenses.name: retry/replay
lenses.question: Can retry or replay duplicate an external or internal side effect?

lenses.name: concurrency
lenses.question: Can two legitimate requests interleave into an invalid state or double effect?

lenses.name: process crash
lenses.question: What happens if the process dies between external side effect and durable commit?

lenses.name: timeout/outcome unknown
lenses.question: Is a timeout distinguished from definitive failure so late success cannot be duplicated?

lenses.name: partial success
lenses.question: Can partial fulfillment, write, payment or mutation be represented as full success?

lenses.name: terminal-state transition
lenses.question: Can a supposedly terminal state be reopened, reclaimed, refunded or mutated incorrectly?

lenses.name: default/coercion
lenses.question: Can null, NaN, empty, false or unknown be coerced into zero/free/allowed/healthy?

lenses.name: normalization mismatch
lenses.question: Can equivalent inputs bypass validation because different layers normalize differently?

lenses.name: stored/second-order input
lenses.question: Can previously stored attacker-controlled data become dangerous when reused in a later query, command, render or tool call?

lenses.name: boundary mismatch
lenses.question: Do UI, API, database, worker and provider layers disagree about the same invariant?

lenses.name: secret/PII exposure
lenses.question: Can responses, logs, bundles, traces, analytics or errors expose secrets or sensitive customer data?

lenses.name: configuration drift
lenses.question: Does an absent, shadow, legacy or environment-specific flag silently disable the intended control?

lenses.name: migration/version drift
lenses.question: Can repo history differ from live schema/function truth in a way that makes deployment unsafe?

lenses.name: supply-chain substitution
lenses.question: Can an untrusted package/action/artifact/source be substituted for the intended dependency?

lenses.name: browser/runtime-only failure
lenses.question: Can bundling, origin, cookie, CSP, hydration or runtime behavior invalidate a control despite green type/unit tests?

lenses.name: agent/tool confusion
lenses.question: Can untrusted content influence tool choice, target, authority, or claimed operator identity?

lenses.name: observability honesty
lenses.question: Can success, health, status, audit or metrics claim an invariant that was not actually proven?

selection_rule: family × lens combinations are candidate hypotheses; mark APPLICABLE, NOT_APPLICABLE, or UNKNOWN_NEEDS_EVIDENCE before testing
